tuition.formula: At most 2193 USD × 31 (per_credit); no verified minimum or exact bill
assumptions: Conservative tuition-only ceiling for the ordinary 31-credit Raleigh on-campus MCS, using the 2026-27 nonresident MCS/MSCS table.
Each uncapped billing credit comprises USD 1,804.11 base tuition plus USD 388.89 tuition increment, or USD 2,193. The table separately lists required fees and the COE fee; those are excluded.

Both tuition components plateau at the nine-plus-credit semester row. Ignoring the plateau bounds the ordinary required-credit tuition by 31 x USD 2,193 = USD 67,983. The actual bill can be lower and needs a term-by-term schedule.

This ceiling excludes repeated or additional coursework, extra enrollment, summer rates not covered by the table, future increases, fees and living costs. The online program and generic graduate table are not substituted.
